$R(^{\nu}y_{n}({\sigma}),\tau)$ is Poisson generated by

(5.103)

$\begin{split}&\{\eta_{a;i,j}^{(r)}|{1\leq a\leq m,1\leq i,j\leq\nu_{a},r>0}\},\\
&\{\theta_{a;i,j}^{(r)}|{1\leq as_{a,a+1}(\nu)}\},\end{split}$

with the following Poisson relations

(5.104)

$\begin{split}\eta_{a;i,j}^{(r)}=(\beta)^{i+j}(-1)^{r}\eta_{a;j^{\prime},i^{\prime}}^{(r)}\end{split}$

(5.105)

$\begin{split}&\hskip 40.0pt\{\eta_{a,i,j}^{(r)},\eta_{b,h,k}^{(s)}\}\\
&=\delta_{a,b}\frac{1}{2}\sum_{t=0}^{\min(r,s)-1}\left(\eta_{a;i,k}^{(r+s-1-t)}\eta_{a;h,j}^{(t)}-\eta_{a;i,k}^{(t)}\eta_{a;h,j}^{(r+s-1-t)}+(\beta)^{h+k}(-1)^{s}\left(\eta_{a;i,h^{\prime}}^{(r+s-1-t)}\eta_{a;k^{\prime},j}^{(t)}-\eta_{a;i,h^{\prime}}^{(t)}\eta_{a;k^{\prime},j}^{(r+s-1-t)}\right)\right)\end{split}$

(5.106)

$\begin{split}\{\eta_{a,i,j}^{(r)},\theta_{b,h,k}^{(s)}\}&=\frac{1}{2}\left(\delta_{h,j}\delta_{a,b}\sum_{t=0}^{r-1}\sum_{g=1}^{\nu_{\alpha}}\eta_{a,i,g}^{(t)}\theta_{a,g,k}^{(r+s-1-t)}-\delta_{a,b+1}\sum_{t=0}^{r-1}\eta_{b+1,i,k}^{(t)}\theta_{b,h,j}^{(r+s-1-t)}\right)\\
&+(\beta)^{i+j}(-1)^{r}\frac{1}{2}\left(\delta_{h,i^{\prime}}\delta_{a,b}\sum_{t=0}^{r-1}\sum_{g=1}^{\nu_{\alpha}}\eta_{a,j^{\prime},g}^{(t)}\theta_{a,g,k}^{(r+s-1-t)}-\delta_{a,b+1}\sum_{t=0}^{r-1}\eta_{b+1,j^{\prime},k}^{(t)}\theta_{b,h,i^{\prime}}^{(r+s-1-t)}\right)\end{split}$

(5.107)

$\begin{split}\{\theta_{a,i,j}^{(r)},\theta_{a,h,k}^{(s)}\}&=\frac{1}{2}\left(\sum_{t=r}^{s-1}\theta_{a,i,k}^{(t)}{\theta}_{a,k,j}^{(r+s-1-t)}+(\beta)^{h+k}(-1)^{s_{a,a+1}+s}\sum_{t=0}^{r+s-1}\widetilde{\eta}_{a,i,h^{\prime}}^{(r+s-1-t)}\eta_{a+1,k^{\prime},j}^{(t)}\right)\ \textnormal{for}\ r
(5.108)
$\displaystyle\{\theta_{a,i,j}^{(r)},\theta_{a+1,h,k}^{(s+1)}\}-\{\theta_{a,i,j}^{(r+1)},\theta_{a+1,h,k}^{(s)}\}=-\frac{1}{2}\delta_{h,j}\left(\sum_{g=1}^{\nu_{a+1}}\theta^{(r)}_{a,i,g}\theta^{(s)}_{a+1,g,k}\right)$
(5.109)
$\displaystyle\{\theta_{a,i,j}^{(r)},\theta_{b,h,k}^{(s)}\}=0\textnormal{ for }b>a+1\textnormal{ or if }b=a+1\textnormal{ and }h\neq j$
(5.110)
$\displaystyle\{\theta_{a,i,j}^{(r)},\{\theta_{a,h,k}^{(s)},\theta_{b,f,g}^{(t)}\}\}+\{\theta_{a,i,j}^{(s)},\{\theta_{a,h,k}^{(r)},\theta_{b,f,g}^{(t)}\}\}=0\textnormal{ if }\mid a-b\mid=1\textnormal{ and }r+s\textnormal{ odd}$
(5.111)
$\begin{split}&\{\theta_{a,i,j}^{(r)},\{\theta_{a,h,k}^{(s)},\theta_{b,f,g}^{(t)}\}\}+\{\theta_{a,i,j}^{(s)},\{\theta_{a,h,k}^{(r)},\theta_{b,f,g}^{(t)}\}\}\\
&\hskip 20.0pt=\frac{1}{2}(\beta)^{i+j}(-1)^{r+s_{a,a+1}+1}\sum_{t^{\prime}=0}^{r+s-1}\left(\widetilde{\eta}_{a;h,i^{\prime}}^{(r+s-1-t^{\prime})}\delta_{a+1,b}\delta_{f,k}\sum_{t^{\prime\prime}=0}^{t^{\prime}-1}\sum_{m=1}^{\nu_{a+1}}\eta_{a+1;j^{\prime},m}^{(t^{\prime\prime})}\theta_{a+1;m,g}^{(t^{\prime}+t-1-t^{\prime\prime})}\right)\\
&\hskip 40.0pt+\frac{1}{2}(\beta)^{i+j}(-1)^{r+s_{a,a+1}+1}\sum_{t^{\prime}=0}^{r+s-1}\left(\eta^{(t^{\prime})}_{a+1,j^{\prime},k}\delta_{a,b+1}\delta_{h,g}\sum_{t^{\prime\prime}=0}^{r-t^{\prime}-1}\sum_{m=1}^{\nu_{a}}\theta_{b;f,m}^{(r-t^{\prime}+t-1-t^{\prime\prime})}\widetilde{\eta}_{a;m,i^{\prime}}^{(t^{\prime\prime})}\right)\\
&\hskip 60.0pt\textnormal{ if }\mid a-b\mid=1\textnormal{ and }r+s\textnormal{ even}.\end{split}$

Here we define $\eta_{a,i,j}^{(0)}=\delta_{i,j}$, $\widetilde{\eta}_{a,i,j}^{(0)}=\delta_{i,j}$ and $\widetilde{\eta}_{a,i,j}^{(r)}=-\sum_{g=1}^{\nu_{a}}\sum_{t=1}^{r}\eta_{a,i,g}^{(t)}\tilde{\eta}_{a,g,j}^{(r-t)}$
card.label: Theorem 5.13

paper.title: Shifted twisted Yangians and Slodowy slices in classical Lie algebras
paper.abstract: In this paper we introduce the shifted twisted Yangian of type {\sf AI}, following the work of Lu--Wang--Zhang, and we study their semiclassical limits, a class of Poisson algebras. We demonstrate that they coincide with the Dirac reductions of the semiclassical shifted Yangian for $\mathfrak{gl}_n$. We deduce that these shifted twisted Yangians admit truncations which are isomorphic to Slodowy slices for many non-rectangular nilpotent elements in types {\sf B}, {\sf C}, {\sf D}. As a direct consequence we obtain parabolic presentations of the semiclassical shifted twisted Yangian, analogous to those introduced by Brundan--Kleshchev for the Yangian of type {\sf A}. Finally we give Poisson presentations of Slodowy slices for all even nilpotent elements in types {\sf B}, {\sf C}, {\sf D}, generalising the recent work of the second author.
